subject: Public Awareness Deck - First Draft
context: Sending a draft deliverable to a client contact, including an apology for a delay.
author: Yancey Dawson
body:
Hey Jennifer,

When you get a chance, please take a look at the first draft of the Public Awareness Deck.

When we spoke a few weeks ago, the action plan had one of the biggest pain points is that stakeholders and others do not fully understand what Public Awareness is or what the team does. This deck is the first step toward addressing that issue.

Once we finalize the deck, I will develop a one-page overview and a two-sided pocket card that can be laminated. After that, I will begin working on the NIPSCO QA/QC Process Document you sent me a few weeks ago.

I am also currently developing a Cross Bore Template and Remediation Flowchart for Adam.

I apologize for the delay been a few weeks. My time has been divided because I have also been helping NIPSCO with several time-sensitive matters and storm-related activities.

Please you and your team review the deck, and I'll schedule something in a week or so we can go from there.

Thanks,

Yancey
